name: Tilbroquinol

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France and Saudi Arabia, first in 1999 — for liver harm

summary: Tilbroquinol was taken off the market in France and Saudi Arabia starting in 1999 due to liver harm [3]. In tests from a small computer model rather than studies in people, the drug received a medium risk score of 55 for the liver [M]. That same computer model also gave it a low risk score of 22 for the heart [M].
